entities.summary: Rashad Andre Jennings is an American former professional football player who was a running back in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Pittsburgh Panthers and the Liberty Flames and was selected by the Jacksonville Jaguars in the seventh round of the 2009 NFL draft. Jennings also played for the Oakland Raiders and the New York Giants.
